summary: Closer view of the smoking oven: the roast inside is burning.
framing: Medium shot, straight on, of the oven against the kitchen back wall; a fast push-in over the first three frames, then static.
props: white oven with glass door window (two diagonal glints), towel-bar handle, upstand with three large and three small knobs
lilac cupboard door with round knob at the left
window at the upper right showing trees and a fence

beats.action: fast push-in toward the oven: 329 is widest (oven about a quarter of frame width), 330 closer, 331 full close framing
two columns of grey smoke rise from the back of the oven top, one each side of the upstand, to the top of frame
static framing: oven centred, about a third of frame width
smoke keeps billowing upward, edges shifting slowly; partly veils the upstand knobs; holds to the end of the shot

notes: Disagrees with timeline.json, which marks S06 static: frames 329 and 330 are visibly wider than 331 onward (window and floor show more), so there is a 3-frame push-in (or the cut lands mid-zoom). From 331 the frame is static. No characters in shot. Nothing moves but the smoke.
